sources.title: Dialetti della Puglia centrale (voce 'Dialetto barese')
sources.reliability_notes: Rich grammar sections (articles, cases, clitics, possessives, verb paradigms, prepositions, negation, comparatives, local variant table) but mixed spellings (iì/ji, ié/jè) and some sections unreferenced; Murgia and south-east forms sit next to city forms, so each form was checked against its label.
sources.relevant_sections: Scrittura, Accenti, Diacronia, Nessi consonantici, Grammatica, Verbi, Varianti locali (riga 'Barese'), Avverbi, Etimologia, Lemmi

sources.title: Barese dialect
sources.reliability_notes: Short, flagged 'more citations needed'. Useful for orthography (accents), essere present paradigm, example interjections and the attestation 'Ce ttremóne!'. The avé table (agghiá/adda/java/amma/avita/avonne) conflicts with other sources and was NOT adopted.
sources.relevant_sections: Orthography, Linguistic features, prayers in city Barese

sources.title: Appendix:Barese Swadesh list

sources.title: trimone (Neapolitan, chiefly Bari)
sources.reliability_notes: Senses 'wank' and 'idiot', local pronunciations (Bari [trɪˈmoː.nə̆], Molfetta [trəˈmoː.nə̆]), etymological hypotheses; cites patrimonilinguistici.it.

sources.title: The Syntax of the Dialect of Bari (PhD dissertation)
sources.author: Luigi Andriani
sources.reliability_notes: Fieldwork-based morphosyntax of urban Barese: SVO/null subjects, impersonal zə, postnominal adjectives and possessives, enclitic kinship possessives, demonstratives (cùssə/cùddə, stu/sta/sti), BE/HAVE paradigms, person-split auxiliary selection (so'/sì/à/sìmə/sìtə/ònnə), present perfect vs preterite, STAND/GO periphrases with inflected 2sg/3sg, stà/scì paradigms, prohibitive with sì+gerund. Only facts and short forms are cited; no passages copied.

sources.title: Trimone: cosa vuol dire in pugliese?

sources.reliability_notes: Popular-linguistics article by a dialect blogger; usage examples, local pronunciations, etymology hypotheses (manico della zappa, tremulare, trumeau, gelatiera, trombone), Piccinni legend.

sources.reliability_notes: Anonymous user entries tagged Reg. Puglia, read via the region index https://slengo.it/browse/region/puglia and each /define/<slug> page. Region tag is 'Puglia', never 'Bari': used only where the form matches existing Barese items.
